extension.description: Searches and downloads Czech/Slovak anime subtitles from hiyori.cz. Requires a hiyori.cz account - set your username and password in this addon's settings. External/forwarded subtitles (hosted on other fansub sites) are listed but not auto-downloaded - each is labelled with the actual site that has it (e.g. "Kamui-Subs"), and selecting one shows the link instead.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a hiyori.cz account, entered in this addon's settings.

extension.description: Searches and downloads Czech anime subtitles from wosir.cz. Requires a wosir.cz account - set your username and password in this addon's settings. Lists both TV and Blu-ray (BD) releases where available.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a wosir.cz account, entered in this addon's settings.

extension.description: Searches and downloads Czech/Slovak TV show subtitles from edna.cz. Requires an edna.cz account - set your username and password in this addon's settings (the site's subtitle listing is only visible while logged in). Only TV series are supported (edna.cz subtitles aren't organized this way for movies). External/forwarded subtitles (hosted on titulky.com) are listed but not auto-downloaded - selecting one shows the link instead. "Celá sezóna" (whole-season bulk download) is not supported.
extension.disclaimer: Requires an edna.cz account, entered in this addon's settings.

extension.description: Searches and downloads Czech anime subtitles from kamui-subs.cz. Requires a kamui-subs.cz account - set your username and password in this addon's settings (the site's episode listing and downloads are only visible while logged in). Each show has its own page per season; downloads are password-protected zip files - set the zip password in this addon's settings too (check kamui-subs.cz if you don't know it), and it's extracted automatically.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a kamui-subs.cz account, entered in this addon's settings.

extension.description: Searches and downloads Czech anime subtitles from Legie Kondor (anime4.legiekondor.cz). No account needed - the whole site is public. Matches Kodi's video metadata (or a manual search) against the site's small, hand-curated anime catalog.

Searches and downloads Czech anime subtitles from NyaSub (nyasub.cz). No account needed - the whole site is public. Matches Kodi's video metadata (or a manual search) against the site's small, hand-curated catalog.

extension.summary: Hanabi.fan subtitles for anime, via Hanabi's own official API
extension.description: Searches and downloads Czech anime subtitles from Hanabi (hanabi.fan) using Hanabi's own official REST API (not site scraping). Requires a personal access token - create one at hanabi.fan under your account settings' "Přístupový token" tab, then paste it into this addon's settings.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a Hanabi.fan account and a personal access token, entered in this addon's settings.

extension.summary: Repository for the Hiyori, WoSir, Edna, Kamui-Subs, Legie Kondor, NyaSub and Hanabi Kodi subtitle addons
extension.description: Adds one repository source so you can browse and install/update the Hiyori.cz, WoSir.cz, Edna.cz, Kamui-Subs.cz, Legie Kondor (anime4.legiekondor.cz), NyaSub.cz and Hanabi (hanabi.fan) subtitle addons directly from Kodi's addon browser, instead of installing each addon's zip separately.
